dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Phew... It's almost time to head back to the ship.

choices.text: Beidou, this gift envelope is for you.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Haha, not too shabby! I like the style, and nice penmanship!

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: #Looks like your skill with a pen is just as good as your skill with a blade, {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm just glad that everyone is safe.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Haha, with your help, that's practically a guarantee!

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: I'm not the only one impressed by your feats. My crew is dying to have a drink with you.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: My tolerance isn't that high, I fear...

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Don't worry — I already got 'em off your back.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: You're fierce on the battlefield. But, when it comes to alcohol, my crew would drink you under the table.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Still, you should join us for a meal when you're free — I'll host.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: In the meantime... I've gotta get back to the ship. I just received payment from the Tianquan, so it's time to divide it among the crew.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Once I do that, I'll start prepping our feast! I'll be in touch.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: See ya! I'll get everything ready for the feast, so no backing out!
